title: Advertising
tipVi: Hãy liên hệ đến trải nghiệm thực tế trên mạng xã hội và linh hoạt sử dụng các từ đồng nghĩa như 'commercial', 'sponsored post' hay 'marketing campaign' thay vì lặp lại từ 'advertisement'.
part1: Do you often see advertisements when you browse the internet?
Have you ever bought something directly because of an advert?
What kind of advertisements do you find most annoying?

part2.prompt: Describe an impressive advertisement that you remember well
bullets: what the advertisement was for
where and when you saw it
what happened in the advertisement
and explain why you found it so memorable

part3: In what ways has digital advertising transformed consumer behavior in recent years?
Should governments introduce stricter regulations on advertisements aimed at children?

title: Art
tipVi: Đừng ngần ngại thừa nhận nếu bạn không am hiểu nghệ thuật; hãy tập trung mô tả cảm xúc cá nhân và tác động thị giác thay vì cố dùng thuật ngữ chuyên môn quá phức tạp.
part1: Do you enjoy visiting art galleries or exhibitions?
Did you learn how to draw or paint when you were a child?
Do you have any artwork displayed on the walls of your home?

part2.prompt: Describe a piece of art that left a strong impression on you
bullets: what it was and where you saw it
what it looked like
who created it
and explain why it left such a strong impression on you

part3: Why do some people consider traditional art forms more valuable than digital artwork?
Should governments allocate significant public funds to support artists and cultural institutions?

title: Birthdays and Gifts
tipVi: Khi nói về quà tặng và sinh nhật, hãy tập trung vào giá trị tình cảm và sự tinh tế đằng sau món quà thay vì chỉ miêu tả giá trị vật chất để câu trả lời có chiều sâu hơn.
part1: How do you usually celebrate your birthday?
What kind of gifts do you prefer receiving from your close friends?
Do you think it is difficult to choose a suitable present for someone?

part2.prompt: Describe a meaningful birthday gift you received that made a strong impression on you
bullets: what the gift was
who gave it to you and when you received it
how you reacted upon receiving it
and explain why this gift held special meaning for you

part3: In what ways has the way people celebrate birthdays evolved compared to previous generations?
Do you believe commercialization has diminished the genuine sentimental value of giving presents?

title: Celebrities
tipVi: Hãy tránh việc chỉ liệt kê tiểu sử ngày tháng năm sinh của người nổi tiếng mà hãy tập trung phân tích lý do bạn ngưỡng mộ và sức ảnh hưởng xã hội của họ.
part1: Do you follow any famous people on social media?
Who was your favorite celebrity when you were a child?
Would you like to be famous in the future?

part2.prompt: Describe a celebrity you admire who uses their fame to help others
bullets: who this person is
what achievements they are famous for
how they use their influence to make a positive impact
and explain why you admire this particular celebrity.

part3: Do you think celebrities have a moral responsibility to be positive role models for young people?
How has social media changed the relationship between public figures and their fans?

title: Childhood
tipVi: Hãy kết hợp nhuần nhuyễn thì quá khứ đơn với cấu trúc 'used to' hoặc 'would + V' để miêu tả những thói quen đã qua một cách tự nhiên và chính xác.
part1: Did you enjoy your childhood?
What was your favourite game to play when you were younger?
Who was your closest friend during your primary school years?

part2.prompt: Describe a memorable outdoor activity you enjoyed during your childhood
bullets: what activity it was
where you usually did it
who you took part in it with
and explain why this activity left such a deep impression on you

part3: How have children's leisure activities changed compared to several decades ago?
To what extent does a person's childhood environment shape their adult personality?

title: Films and Cinema
tipVi: Hãy tập trung miêu tả cảm xúc và thông điệp của bộ phim thay vì chỉ tóm tắt cốt truyện quá chi tiết.
part1: How often do you go to the cinema to watch a movie?
What genre of films do you usually prefer watching?
Did you enjoy watching movies when you were a child?

part2.prompt: Describe an inspiring film that made a lasting impression on you
bullets: what the film was about
when and where you watched it
who the main characters were
and explain why this film made such a strong impression on you

part3: Why do some people still prefer watching films in theaters rather than on streaming platforms?
To what extent can films influence people's moral values and worldview?

title: Climate Change
tipVi: Hãy liên hệ các hiện tượng thời tiết cực đoan hoặc thói quen sống xanh hằng ngày tại địa phương thay vì chỉ đưa ra các số liệu khoa học vĩ mô khô khan.
part1: Have you noticed any changes in the weather in your hometown recently?
What do you do in your daily life to protect the environment?
Do you think schools should teach children about environmental issues?

part2.prompt: Describe an environmental initiative or project you know that tackles climate change
bullets: what the initiative or project is
where and how it is carried out
who participates in or supports it
and explain why you think it is effective in combating climate change

part3: Who should bear the primary responsibility for tackling global warming: individuals or governments?
How might technological advancements help reduce the impact of climate change in the future?

title: Clothes and Fashion
tipVi: Hãy chú ý mô tả chất liệu, phom dáng và ngữ cảnh sử dụng thay vì chỉ lặp lại các tính từ chung chung như 'beautiful' hay 'nice'.
part1: What kinds of clothes do you usually like to wear?
Do you prefer shopping for clothes online or in physical stores?
Did you have to wear a school uniform when you were younger?

part2.prompt: Describe an item of clothing you wear on special occasions
bullets: what it looks like and where you got it
when and where you wear it
how often you wear it
and explain why you enjoy wearing it

part3: Why do some people spend an excessive amount of money on designer brands?
How has the rise of fast fashion impacted the environment and consumer behavior?

title: Cooking
tipVi: Hãy sử dụng các động từ chỉ thao tác nấu nướng cụ thể cùng tính từ miêu tả hương vị và kết cấu thay vì lặp lại những từ chung chung như 'cook' hay 'delicious'.
part1: Do you often cook your own meals at home?
What was the very first dish you learned to make?
Do you prefer eating home-cooked food or dining out?

part2.prompt: Describe a special meal or dish that you know how to prepare
bullets: what dish it is and what ingredients are needed
who taught you how to prepare it or how you learned it
how you usually cook this dish
and explain why you enjoy cooking this particular meal

part3: Should schools include culinary skills as a compulsory subject for young students?
How has modern technology changed the way families prepare and consume food?

title: Culture and Traditions
tipVi: Khi nói về văn hóa, hãy tránh dịch thô từng chữ các khái niệm truyền thống sang tiếng Anh mà nên dùng từ vựng diễn giải súc tích kết hợp chia sẻ cảm xúc cá nhân.
part1: Do you enjoy learning about traditions from other countries?
What is an important celebration in your hometown?
Did your family have any special customs when you were growing up?

part2.prompt: Describe a traditional festival or cultural event in your country that you find meaningful.
bullets: what the festival is
when and where it takes place
what people usually do during this event
and explain why this celebration is meaningful to you

part3: How has globalization affected the way younger generations view traditional customs?
Do you think governments should invest public funds in preserving endangered cultural rituals?

title: Daily Routine
tipVi: Hãy sử dụng linh hoạt các trạng từ chỉ tần suất và các cụm động từ chỉ chuỗi hành động thay vì chỉ liệt kê các mốc thời gian một cách máy móc.
part1: What is the first thing you usually do after waking up?
Do you prefer to do challenging tasks in the morning or in the evening?
Has your daily routine changed much compared to when you were younger?

part2.prompt: Describe a healthy habit that has become an important part of your daily routine
bullets: what the habit is
when and how you started doing it
how it fits into your daily schedule
and explain why this habit is so beneficial to your daily life

part3: Why do some people find it difficult to stick to a consistent daily schedule?
How has modern technology influenced the way people organize their day-to-day lives?

title: Festivals
tipVi: Hãy kết hợp miêu tả bầu không khí náo nhiệt bằng các tính từ giàu hình ảnh cùng với ý nghĩa văn hóa sâu xa thay vì chỉ liệt kê các hoạt động ăn uống hay vui chơi thông thường.
part1: What is your favorite traditional festival in your country?
How do people usually celebrate public holidays where you live?
Do you prefer spending festival times with your family or friends?

part2.prompt: Describe an exciting festival or cultural celebration you experienced.
bullets: what the festival was and where it took place
who you went with or met there
what activities or rituals you participated in
and explain why this celebration was particularly memorable to you

part3: In what ways do commercial promotions alter the traditional essence of cultural festivals?
Why might younger generations feel less connected to ancient customs and folk celebrations?

title: Gardens and Plants
tipVi: Hãy kết hợp từ vựng miêu tả cảm giác thư thái và tác động của mảng xanh đối với sức khỏe tinh thần thay vì chỉ liệt kê tên các loài thực vật.
part1: Do you have any potted plants or flowers in your home?
Did you enjoy visiting public gardens when you were a child?
Would you like to grow your own vegetables in the future?

part2.prompt: Describe a memorable garden or park with plants that you have visited
bullets: where this garden or park is located
what kinds of plants or flowers you saw there
what you did during your visit
and explain why this visit left such a strong impression on you

part3: Why do many urban residents find it important to maintain green spaces in modern cities?
How might children benefit from participating in gardening activities at school?

title: Handwriting and Typing
tipVi: Hãy khéo léo kết hợp các cấu trúc so sánh đối chiếu giữa tính hiệu quả tiện lợi của việc gõ phím với giá trị cảm xúc và lợi ích tư duy sâu của chữ viết tay.
part1: Do you prefer writing by hand or typing on a keyboard?
When was the last time you wrote something by hand?
Do you think handwriting will still be important in the future?

part2.prompt: Describe a handwritten letter or card that you received.
bullets: who sent it to you
what the message was about
when and where you received it
and explain why this handwritten message was special to you

part3: In what situations do people still prefer handwriting over digital typing?
Should primary schools allocate more curriculum time to keyboard skills than penmanship?

title: Happiness
tipVi: Hãy tránh lạm dụng từ 'happy' bằng cách linh hoạt sử dụng các tính từ và thành ngữ chỉ cảm xúc như 'content', 'over the moon' hoặc 'a sense of fulfillment', đồng thời liên hệ cụ thể với trải nghiệm đời sống.
part1: What kinds of things make you feel happy in your daily life?
Do you think you were happier when you were a child than you are now?
What do you usually do when you want to cheer yourself up after a hard day?

part2.prompt: Describe an unexpected event that brought you immense happiness
bullets: what the event was
when and where it happened
who shared that moment with you
and explain why it brought you such immense happiness

part3: Do you believe that material wealth is essential for long-term happiness in modern society?
How has the way people define happiness changed compared to previous generations?

title: Hobbies
tipVi: Thay vì lặp lại cấu trúc 'In my free time, I like...', hãy dùng các diễn đạt linh hoạt như 'I tend to unwind by...' hoặc 'I am keen on...' kết hợp làm rõ cảm xúc và lợi ích tinh thần.
part1: Do you have any hobbies that you prefer doing alone rather than with others?
Did you spend your leisure time differently when you were a child?
Is there a new hobby or creative pursuit you would like to take up soon?

part2.prompt: Describe a hobby or leisure activity you recently took up
bullets: what the activity is
how you first learned about it
how often you engage in it
and explain why this hobby has become meaningful to you

part3: Why do some people find it difficult to maintain a regular hobby in modern society?
To what extent can hobbies influence an individual's personal or professional growth?

title: Housing
tipVi: Khi nói về nhà ở, hãy tránh chỉ liệt kê đồ đạc tĩnh mà nên tập trung miêu tả không gian sống, cảm giác thoải mái và thói quen sinh hoạt gắn liền với ngôi nhà.
part1: Do you live in a house or an apartment?
What is your favourite room in your home?
Would you like to move to a different home in the future?

part2.prompt: Describe an ideal home you would like to live in
bullets: where this home would be located
what kind of accommodation it would be
what features or amenities it would have
and explain why you would choose to live in this particular place

part3: What are the main differences between living in a city apartment and living in a countryside house?
How might housing designs change over the next few decades due to environmental challenges?

title: The Internet
tipVi: Hãy tránh lạm dụng các từ chung chung như 'good' hay 'convenient', thay vào đó hãy dùng các cụm từ chuyên biệt như 'streamline workflow' hay 'information overload' để nâng band điểm từ vựng.
part1: How much time do you spend online every day?
What do you usually use the internet for?
Do you think you could live without an internet connection for a week?

part2.prompt: Describe an online platform or website that you find particularly useful
bullets: what platform or website it is
how often you visit it
what features or content it offers
and explain why you find it so useful in your daily life

part3: How has internet access changed the way people acquire knowledge compared to the past?
What are the main risks associated with children having unrestricted access to the web?

title: Job Interviews
tipVi: Hãy kết hợp thuật ngữ nghề nghiệp tự nhiên cùng việc chia sẻ cảm xúc chân thật thay vì chỉ liệt kê các câu hỏi phỏng vấn thông thường.
part1: Have you ever attended a job interview?
How do people usually prepare for an interview in your country?
Do you think wearing formal clothes to an interview is still necessary?

part2.prompt: Describe a memorable job interview you had or heard about
bullets: what the position was
who the interviewer was
what happened during the interview
and explain why this interview was memorable to you

part3: How have recruitment methods changed over the past decade?
Do you think artificial intelligence will completely replace human recruiters in the future?

title: Jobs and Careers
tipVi: Hãy linh hoạt kết hợp các cụm từ chỉ trách nhiệm và môi trường làm việc thay vì chỉ liệt kê các nhiệm vụ lặp đi lặp lại một cách đơn điệu.
part1: Do you currently work or are you a student?
What do you enjoy most about your daily work routine?
Would you like to change your job or career path in the future?

part2.prompt: Describe an ideal job you would like to have in the future
bullets: what job it is
what qualifications or skills are needed for it
what responsibilities you would have in this role
and explain why you consider this to be your ideal career

part3: How do you think artificial intelligence will change the nature of employment in the coming decades?
Should governments prioritize job security or labor market flexibility when formulating economic policies?

title: Language Learning
tipVi: Khi nói về việc học ngoại ngữ, hãy chia sẻ trải nghiệm thực tế kèm phương pháp cụ thể thay vì chỉ liệt kê các lợi ích chung chung.
part1: How many languages can you speak?
What do you find most challenging about learning a new language?
Do you prefer learning a language independently or in a classroom?

part2.prompt: Describe a foreign language you would like to learn in the future
bullets: what language it is
how you plan to learn it
what difficulties you might encounter
and explain why you want to learn this particular language

part3: Do you think artificial intelligence and translation tools will make language learning obsolete?
Why do children often pick up foreign languages more quickly than adults?

title: Leadership
tipVi: Khi nói về lãnh đạo, hãy tránh liệt kê các tính từ chung chung như 'good' hay 'smart'; thay vào đó, hãy dùng ngôn ngữ quản trị Band 7+ như 'lead by example', 'delegate tasks' và kể một tình huống xử lý áp lực cụ thể.
part1: Have you ever been the leader of a team or a project?
Do you prefer working independently or leading a group?
What kind of qualities do you think make a good school monitor or team captain?

part2.prompt: Describe an effective leader you have worked with or know about
bullets: who this person is
when and where you met or saw them lead
what they did to manage the situation
and explain why you think their leadership was effective

part3: Do you think great leaders are born with their abilities, or can leadership be taught?
How has the definition of a good leader changed compared to past generations?

title: Libraries
tipVi: Khi nói về thư viện, hãy tránh chỉ lặp lại ý 'nơi yên tĩnh để đọc sách' mà nên mở rộng sang các góc nhìn như chuyển đổi số, không gian tự học đa năng và vai trò bình đẳng hóa cơ hội tiếp cận tri thức.
part1: How often do you visit libraries?
Did you go to a library when you were a child?
Do you prefer studying in a library or at home?

part2.prompt: Describe a memorable library you have visited
bullets: where this library is located
what facilities and resources it offers
what you did there during your visit
and explain why this library left such a strong impression on you

part3: In what ways have digital resources altered the traditional role of libraries?
Should governments continue to allocate public funds to maintain physical libraries?

title: Memory
tipVi: Hãy kết hợp linh hoạt các thì quá khứ với những cụm từ diễn tả mức độ rõ ràng của ký ức như 'vividly recall' hay 'hazy memory' thay vì chỉ lặp lại động từ 'remember'.
part1: Do you have a good memory for numbers or names?
How do you usually remind yourself of important tasks?
Have you ever forgotten something really important?

part2.prompt: Describe an important childhood event that you remember clearly
bullets: what the event was
when and where it happened
who was there with you
and explain why you still remember it so vividly

part3: Why do people tend to remember negative experiences more vividly than positive ones?
How has modern technology influenced human memory and retention skills?

title: Mobile Apps
tipVi: Thay vì chỉ liệt kê các ứng dụng quen thuộc như Facebook hay TikTok, hãy tập trung miêu tả tính năng cụ thể và tác động thực tế của ứng dụng đó đến thói quen sinh hoạt hoặc học tập của bạn.
part1: What kinds of mobile apps do you use most frequently on your smartphone?
Have your preferences for apps changed compared to when you were younger?
Do you think you spend too much time using mobile applications?

part2.prompt: Describe a mobile app that you find extremely useful in your daily routine.
bullets: what the app is and how you learned about it
what specific features it offers
how often and in what situations you use it
and explain why you find it so essential to your everyday life

part3: How have mobile applications altered the way people communicate in modern society?
To what extent do you agree that mobile software may pose significant risks to personal privacy?

title: Money
tipVi: Thay vì chỉ lặp lại từ 'money', hãy linh hoạt sử dụng các từ vựng cụ thể hơn như 'finances', 'budget', hay 'expenses' và gắn câu trả lời với thói quen chi tiêu thực tế của bản thân.
part1: Do you prefer paying with cash or using digital payment methods?
Did you save money when you were a child?
What kind of things do you usually spend most of your money on?

part2.prompt: Describe a time when you saved up money to buy something special
bullets: what you wanted to buy
how long it took you to save the money
how you managed to save it
and explain why you were pleased with this purchase

part3: Why do some people find it difficult to manage their personal finances effectively?
To what extent should financial literacy be taught as a compulsory subject in schools?

title: Museums
tipVi: Hãy kết hợp miêu tả trải nghiệm giác quan và cảm xúc cá nhân thay vì chỉ liệt kê các hiện vật khô khan để đạt điểm Lexical Resource cao hơn.
part1: Do you often visit museums or art galleries?
What kind of museums do you find most interesting?
Did you go to any museums when you were a child?

part2.prompt: Describe a museum or exhibition that left a strong impression on you
bullets: where this museum or exhibition is located
what kind of exhibits were on display
who you visited it with
and explain why it left such a strong impression on you

part3: Should public museums charge admission fees or be entirely free for citizens?
How might virtual museum tours change the way people appreciate cultural heritage in the future?

title: Nature and Parks
tipVi: Khi nói về thiên nhiên, hãy linh hoạt miêu tả các giác quan (âm thanh, mùi hương, cảnh sắc) và cảm xúc thư giãn cá nhân thay vì chỉ liệt kê đơn điệu tên các loại cây hay địa danh.
part1: Do you often visit parks or botanical gardens?
What do you usually like to do when you are in natural surroundings?
Did you spend much time outdoors when you were a child?

part2.prompt: Describe an impressive natural park or green space you have visited
bullets: where this place is located
what it looks like and what activities you did there
who accompanied you on the trip
and explain why this natural park left such a strong impression on you

part3: Why is it important for cities to incorporate public green spaces into urban planning?
How might modern technology affect younger generations' connection with the natural world?

title: Neighbours
tipVi: Hãy kết hợp việc kể lại trải nghiệm giao tiếp thực tế với các cụm từ chỉ tính gắn kết cộng đồng để câu trả lời vừa gần gũi vừa đạt điểm từ vựng cao.
part1: How well do you know the people who live next door to you?
How often do you interact with your neighbours?
Do you think it is important to have a good relationship with your neighbours?

part2.prompt: Describe a neighbour who has had a positive impact on your local community
bullets: who this person is
how you first met them
what they have done to help the neighbourhood
and explain why you think their actions made such a positive difference

part3: In what ways has urbanisation changed the relationship between neighbours in modern cities?
To what extent should local governments encourage neighbourhood bonding activities?

title: News
tipVi: Hãy tránh chỉ liệt kê các kênh tin tức; thay vào đó, hãy tập trung vào thói quen tiếp nhận thông tin, tính xác thực của tin tức và tác động tâm lý của các bản tin giật gân.
part1: How do you usually get your daily news?
Do you prefer reading international news or domestic news?
Did you follow the news much when you were younger?

part2.prompt: Describe an interesting piece of news you recently read or watched.
bullets: what the news was about
where and when you learned about it
why you found it interesting
and explain how you felt after hearing this news

part3: Why do many people prefer getting news from social media rather than traditional newspapers?
To what extent should governments regulate fake news on digital platforms?

title: Online Shopping
tipVi: Hãy kết hợp linh hoạt từ vựng chuyên ngành như 'e-commerce platforms' hay 'impulse buying' và cân bằng giữa mặt tiện lợi với rủi ro nhận hàng kém chất lượng để đạt điểm Lexical Resource cao.
part1: How often do you buy things on the internet?
What kind of items do you usually purchase online?
Have you ever encountered any problems when shopping online?

part2.prompt: Describe an online purchase you made that you were really satisfied with
bullets: what item you bought
which platform or website you bought it from
why you decided to buy it online rather than in a physical store
and explain why you were so satisfied with this purchase

part3: How has e-commerce transformed traditional retail businesses in recent years?
Do you think consumer spending habits have become more reckless because of online shopping?

title: Pets and Animals
tipVi: Hãy kết hợp miêu tả đặc điểm hành vi của con vật cùng cảm xúc cá nhân để bài nói sinh động và tự nhiên hơn.
part1: Do you have any pets at home?
What kind of animals did you like when you were a child?
Why do some people prefer having pets over other hobbies?

part2.prompt: Describe a memorable encounter you had with a wild animal
bullets: what animal it was
where and when you encountered it
what the animal was doing
and explain why this encounter was memorable to you

part3: Do you think humans have a moral obligation to protect endangered species?
How has urbanization affected the relationship between humans and wild animals?

title: Photography
tipVi: Hãy kết hợp từ vựng miêu tả cảm xúc, ánh sáng và bố cục thay vì chỉ lặp đi lặp lại những cụm từ đơn giản như 'take photos' hay 'nice pictures'.
part1: Do you enjoy taking photos in your daily life?
How often do you look back at old photographs?
Do you prefer taking photos with a smartphone or a digital camera?

part2.prompt: Describe a memorable photograph you have taken
bullets: when and where you took it
what or who was in the photo
what equipment or settings you used
and explain why this photograph is particularly meaningful to you

part3: Why do some people prefer to capture moments on camera rather than simply enjoying them in the present?
How has digital photography altered the way society preserves history and memories?

title: Public Speaking
tipVi: Hãy thành thật chia sẻ cảm xúc cá nhân như sự hồi hộp ban đầu và cách bạn vượt qua nó thay vì cố tỏ ra mình là một diễn giả hoàn hảo.
part1: Have you ever given a speech or presentation in public?
Do you feel nervous when speaking in front of a group of people?
Would you like to improve your public speaking skills in the future?

part2.prompt: Describe a speech or presentation that you gave to a large audience
bullets: when and where you gave it
what topic you talked about
who was in the audience
and explain how you felt before and after delivering the talk

part3: Why do many people find speaking in public terrifying?
How important is body language compared to spoken words during a speech?

title: Safety and Crime
tipVi: Khi thảo luận về an toàn và tội phạm, hãy cân bằng giữa góc nhìn cá nhân và xã hội, đồng thời sử dụng các thuật ngữ tư pháp và phòng ngừa chính xác thay vì những từ ngữ tiêu cực chung chung.
part1: Do you feel safe walking alone in your neighborhood at night?
What do you usually do to keep your personal belongings safe when traveling?
Have you ever witnessed or reported a minor crime?

part2.prompt: Describe a situation when you felt unsafe or worried about your personal security
bullets: when and where it happened
what caused you to feel unsafe
what actions you took to protect yourself
and explain how you felt after the incident was over

part3: Do you think installing more surveillance cameras in public places effectively deters criminal activities?
How might advancements in digital technology change the types of crimes committed in the future?

title: Science
tipVi: Đừng biến câu trả lời thành bài giảng lý thuyết khô khan; hãy liên hệ kiến thức khoa học với trải nghiệm cá nhân hoặc ứng dụng thực tiễn trong đời sống để tạo cảm giác tự nhiên.
part1: Did you enjoy learning science subjects when you were in school?
What area of science do you find most interesting nowadays?
Do you often watch science documentaries or read science news?

part2.prompt: Describe an interesting scientific experiment or theory you learned about
bullets: what it is about
when and where you first learned about it
how it works or how it is conducted
and explain why you found it particularly fascinating

part3: To what extent should scientific research be funded by the government rather than private corporations?
How can schools encourage more young people, especially girls, to pursue careers in science?

title: Sleep
tipVi: Hãy sử dụng các cụm từ học thuật hoặc tự nhiên về thói quen sinh hoạt (như circadian rhythm, sleep hygiene) thay vì chỉ lặp đi lặp lại 'sleep well' hay 'go to bed'.
part1: How many hours of sleep do you usually get each night?
Do you find it easy or difficult to fall asleep?
Do you ever take naps during the middle of the day?

part2.prompt: Describe an occasion when you had trouble sleeping.
bullets: when and where this happened
what caused you to stay awake
what you did to try to sleep
and explain how you felt the next day.

part3: How has modern technology altered people's sleeping habits in recent years?
Should employers encourage their staff to take short naps during the workday?

title: Social Media
tipVi: Hãy tránh chỉ liệt kê tên ứng dụng như Facebook hay TikTok; thay vào đó, hãy tập trung vào thói quen sử dụng, cảm xúc và tác động của nội dung số lên tâm lý cá nhân.
part1: How often do you use social media platforms?
Which social media app do you spend the most time on?
Do you think people in your country spend too much time on social networking sites?

part2.prompt: Describe an interesting social media account or channel you follow
bullets: what platform it is on and who runs it
what kind of content they share
how often you check or interact with this account
and explain why you find this account interesting or worthwhile to follow

part3: How has social media transformed the way young people communicate with each other?
Do you think social media platforms should be held accountable for misleading information?

title: Sports Events
tipVi: Hãy tập trung miêu tả bầu không khí cuồng nhiệt và cảm xúc thăng trầm thay vì chỉ mải mê thuật lại tỉ số hay luật chơi.
part1: Do you enjoy watching sports competitions live or on television?
Have you ever attended a major sporting event in person?
What kind of sports tournaments are popular in your country?

part2.prompt: Describe a memorable sports event you watched or attended
bullets: what the event was and where it took place
who you watched it with
what happened during the competition
and explain why this event was so memorable to you

part3: What are the benefits and drawbacks of a country hosting an international tournament like the Olympics?
Why do professional athletes receive substantially higher salaries than people in essential professions like teaching or healthcare?

title: Stress and Relaxation
tipVi: Hãy sử dụng linh hoạt các cụm từ chỉ cường độ căng thẳng và cách giải tỏa thay vì lặp lại từ 'stress' hay 'relax', đồng thời đưa ví dụ cụ thể về thói quen cá nhân.
part1: What do you usually do when you feel stressed?
Do you think your daily life is more stressful than in the past?
Where is your favourite place to unwind?

part2.prompt: Describe an activity you do that helps you relieve stress
bullets: what the activity is
where and when you usually do it
who you do it with, or if you do it alone
and explain why this activity helps you feel calm and refreshed

part3: Why do you think modern lifestyle causes more mental pressure than in previous generations?
Should employers take responsibility for reducing their employees' workplace stress?

title: Teachers
tipVi: Khi nói về thầy cô, hãy tránh lặp lại các tính từ cơ bản như 'good' hay 'kind', thay vào đó hãy miêu tả cụ thể phương pháp giảng dạy và tác động lâu dài của họ đối với tư duy của bạn.
part1: Do you remember your first teacher from primary school?
What qualities do you think make a good teacher?
Would you ever consider becoming a teacher in the future?

part2.prompt: Describe a teacher who had a significant influence on your education
bullets: who this teacher was and what subject they taught
when and where you were taught by them
what made their teaching style special or unique
and explain why this teacher had such a lasting impact on you

part3: How has the role of teachers changed with the rise of modern educational technology?
Should teachers be primarily responsible for teaching academic subjects or moral values to children?

title: Teamwork
tipVi: Hãy minh họa cụ thể cách phân chia vai trò và cách nhóm giải quyết bất đồng, tránh chỉ dùng những từ chung chung như 'good' hay 'helpful'.
part1: Do you prefer working on your own or in a group?
What was the last project you completed with other people?
Do you find it difficult to cooperate with people you do not know well?

part2.prompt: Describe an effective team project you took part in.
bullets: what the project was and who you worked with
how tasks were divided among team members
what challenges your team encountered
and explain why you think this team project was successful

part3: What key qualities make an individual an effective team player?
How has modern technology changed the way teams collaborate in the workplace?

title: Television
tipVi: Hãy phân biệt rõ giữa truyền hình truyền thống (linear television) và các nền tảng xem phim trực tuyến (streaming services) để thể hiện tư duy cập nhật và vốn từ vựng phong phú.
part1: How often do you watch television programs?
What kind of TV shows do you enjoy watching the most?
Do you prefer watching television alone or with other people?

part2.prompt: Describe an educational television program you enjoy watching
bullets: what the program is
when and where you usually watch it
what topic or subject it covers
and explain why you find this program beneficial or engaging

part3: How has the way people consume television content changed over recent decades?
To what extent should governments regulate educational versus entertainment content on public television?

title: Time Management
tipVi: Hãy tránh chỉ liệt kê các hoạt động trong ngày, thay vào đó hãy nhấn mạnh phương pháp bạn chọn ưu tiên công việc và cách bạn duy trì sự cân bằng cuộc sống.
part1: Do you usually plan your day in advance?
What do you find most difficult about managing your time?
Did you learn how to manage your time when you were a child?

part2.prompt: Describe a technique or habit you use to manage your time effectively
bullets: what technique or habit it is
when and how you started using it
how it helps you organise your daily routine
and explain why you think it works well for you

part3: Why do some people struggle to balance their work commitments and personal life nowadays?
To what extent can digital tools improve personal productivity compared to traditional paper planners?

title: Tourism
tipVi: Hãy cân bằng giữa việc chia sẻ trải nghiệm cá nhân và việc phân tích tác động hai mặt của du lịch đối với kinh tế và môi trường để ghi điểm từ vựng học thuật.
part1: Do you enjoy travelling to crowded tourist destinations?
What kind of places do you prefer to visit during holidays?
Has your hometown become more popular with tourists in recent years?

part2.prompt: Describe a popular tourist attraction you visited that was very crowded
bullets: where this place is
when and why you went there
what you did while you were there
and explain how you felt about the large number of visitors

part3: What negative consequences can mass tourism bring to local communities?
How might governments strike a balance between promoting tourism and protecting the environment?

title: Transport
tipVi: Hãy kết hợp linh hoạt từ vựng miêu tả cơ sở hạ tầng và thói quen đi lại cá nhân, tránh chỉ lặp đi lặp lại các danh từ phương tiện cơ bản như motorbike hay bus.
part1: How do you usually commute to work or school?
Have your travel habits changed over the past few years?
Do you think public transport in your hometown is efficient?

part2.prompt: Describe a journey on public transport that was memorable to you
bullets: what form of transport you took
where and when this journey took place
who you travelled with
and explain why this journey was so memorable to you

part3: What measures can city planners take to encourage more citizens to use public transit?
Do you believe that high-speed rail networks will eventually replace domestic flights?

title: Volunteering
tipVi: Hãy chia sẻ một trải nghiệm thực tế cụ thể và làm nổi bật sự tác động tích cực thay vì chỉ nói lý thuyết chung chung về lòng nhân ái.
part1: Have you ever done any voluntary work?
Would you like to volunteer in the future?
What kinds of volunteer activities are popular among young people in your country?

part2.prompt: Describe a voluntary activity you took part in or would like to join
bullets: what the activity was
where and when it took place (or would take place)
who you did it with (or would do it with)
and explain why you decided to join (or want to join) this activity

part3: Should voluntary work be compulsory for high school students before graduation?
How can non-profit organizations encourage more people to participate in community service?

title: Weekends
tipVi: Thay vì chỉ liệt kê một chuỗi hoạt động tẻ nhạt, hãy tập trung làm nổi bật sự tương phản giữa guồng quay bận rộn trong tuần và cảm giác phục hồi năng lượng thể chất lẫn tinh thần vào cuối tuần.
part1: How do you usually spend your weekends?
Do you prefer spending weekends with friends or alone?
Did you have more free time on weekends when you were a child?

part2.prompt: Describe a memorable weekend activity you did recently
bullets: what the activity was
who you did it with
where you went
and explain why this weekend was memorable to you

part3: How have people's weekend habits changed over the past few decades?
Should employers be allowed to contact employees about work during weekends?
